notes_for_editor: Single newspaper report (The Daily Tribune, 1970, as quoted on Forest Lookouts) is the only tower-specific source. No build date, builder or design found, so none are stated. One WebSearch found nothing on a tower at Nepco Lake. The Wood County Nepco Lake page returned no readable text. DO NOT MIX: the 1928 article quoted on the same Forest Lookouts page describes the company's new tower in Ashland and Sawyer counties, a different tower; left out. Brief height 18.3 m equals 60 ft from the 1970 report. The brief's name 'Nursery (Nepco Lake)' is the lookout list's spelling; no source explains the name 'Nursery' or links the name 'Nepco' to the company. Searches: 1 WebSearch, 2 page reads.
